messages:
morgan: Quick q — do we want the rerank endpoint to return both raw logits and a normalized score? thinking about downstream calibration and model hedging.
ash: Currently we return a single float score in [0,1]. Raw logits would help internal evals/A/B but increases payload and maybe privacy surface.
priya: Adding logits impacts billing. are we charging per-candidate or per-score-unit? we should define 'score_units' first.
zack: Proposal: score_units = candidates * model_cost_weight. model_cost_weight defaults to 1 for small models, 2-4 for bigger ones. That keeps billing predictable when fanout changes.
sylvia: Console needs to show score distribution per-model if we expose logits — histograms + outlier alerts. also surface fallbacks (model_hedge -> fallback_model).
morgan: Sketch of response shape I'm thinking about:
```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1","score":0.86,"logit":3.1},
    {"id":"c2","score":0.12,"logit":-2.0}
  ],
  "score_units_consumed": 12,
  "model_used":"rerank-v2",
  "fallbacks":[{"when":"latency>200ms","to":"rerank-v1"}]
}
```
priya: If we include both values, telemetry needs both histograms (logits) and normalized score histograms. plus counters: model_hedge_fallbacks, quota_denied, score_truncation.
ash: For rollout: start logits-only in canary 5%, collect calibration and size impact, then gradually enable normalized scores in 25/50/100. :thumbsup:
rerank-bot: deploybot: canary started for rerank-service v2 -> 5% on prod-us-east-1 2024-11-08T15:23Z
zack: Also we need an adaptive-throttling rule: if score_units_consumed/sec > tenant_quota*0.9 then reduce candidates max and emit quota_warning metric.
sylvia: UX note: Console should let SREs ban raw_logits for customer-facing routes (sensitive PII concerns). add a toggle per-route in rollouts page.
morgan: OK seems we have agreement on units + canary plan. Action items: priya write new telemetry spec, ash add response shape + feature flag, zack update quota calc. I'll post a PR template for the API contract.
priya: I'll add counters and histograms, plus a sample query for console dashboards. will ping when done.
ash: Thanks, team. if we hit disagreements on exact charge formula, let's do small experiements and measure per-token costs.
rerank-bot: note: issue #4821 created: "score-units and logits telemetry spec" (assigned: priya)
